# madelung-constants

Ewald-summed Madelung constants for ionic crystals

Generated by `scripts/regenerate_doc_examples.py` from the canonical
input `input-madelung-constants.py`.

## Files

- `input-madelung-constants.py`: input script
- `stdout.txt`: full captured stdout from the queued run
- `stderr.txt`: full captured stderr from the queued run
- `artifact-status.json`: machine-readable run status
- `output-madelung-constants.out`
- QVF not expected: this legacy diagnostic does not use the unified QVF writer

## Reproduce

```sh
.venv/bin/python examples/periodic/input-madelung-constants.py
```
